release_notes: Your timezone everywhere, sortable dashboard blocks, and bulk domain adds that no longer time out. Click times, charts and reports follow the profile timezone instead of UTC; the date picker lists every timezone with yours on top. Dashboard blocks sort by any column before taking the top 10. A pasted list of domains is added in the background one by one, so a Cloudflare-proxied panel no longer answers 524. A default Revshare conversion type sends status=revshare to profit. A zero Dynadot balance shows as EUR 0.00. Migration 58 adds the Revshare type unless you already map revshare; update as usual.
